Subject: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so your security team can run an intake: 

- Ask: Please share the preferred route for accessing Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (portal vs. emailed copy).
- Bridge letter: We can provide a temporary attestation / bridge letter if you need an interim document while the full report is routed.
- Trust portal: We typically provision access to our secure Trust Portal for artifacts (reports, bridge letters, config docs).
- Vendor security questionnaire: happy to complete yours — I can attach our standard VSQ if that helps pre-fill a few fields.

Can you confirm the primary security contact and whether Helium prefers a PDF copy of the Type II report or portal access? Once you confirm, I'll loop in Irene (security) for the technical details (KMS, encryption, retention, DPA).

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm contact for intake + whether portal access or emailed report is preferred (reply to this thread).
2) We provision Trust Portal access and share a temporary attestation if needed (Irene will handle).
3) You send the VSQ; I'll return a completed copy and any supporting docs.

Attaching: Redwood_TrustPortal_Instructions.pdf (portal walkthrough + expected timeline).

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the demo. Quick answers from my side:

- Primary intake: I'm the lead for security intake and will coordinate with our procurement team (cc'd).
- Preference: Portal access is preferred so we can onboard multiple reviewers. If portal access will take longer than 5 business days, a PDF copy of the Type II report would be helpful in the interim.
- VSQ: Attaching our vendor security questionnaire (Helium_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). Please have a technical resource answer cryptography, key management, and data residency questions.

A few specific asks we have up front:
1) Does Redwood support customer-managed keys (KMS / HSM)?
2) Is data encrypted at rest and in transit (algorithms/version)?
3) Which regions do you persist PHI/PII in? We need HIPAA scope confirmation and any relevant GDPR controls if data flows EU->US.

Can you loop in your security contact to respond to the three items above and provision portal access?

Thanks,
Sarah Park
Security Program Manager, Helium Health
sarah.park@heliumhealth.com
[Attachment: Helium_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & trust portal access

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the clear list of asks. I'm Irene on Redwood's security team — copying Ben/Marissa so they're aware of timelines. Below are answers and the next steps to get your reviewers access.

Short answers to your three questions:
- Customer-managed keys: We offer integrations with major cloud KMS providers for Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted API customers we currently manage KMS; we can provide architecture details and an HSM-backed key option for enterprise contracts.
- Encryption: Data in transit is TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 encouraged). At-rest encryption uses AES-256 for storage volumes and encrypted token caches. We also support application-layer encryption for sensitive fields on request.
- Regions & regulatory scope: Hosted instances persist data in the region chosen at account creation (us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1). For HIPAA/GDPR scope: we have a HIPAA program and can sign a BAA; GDPR controls are documented in our DPA. Please flag which datasets you consider PHI so we can confirm scope.

Portal access & artifacts:
- Trust Portal: I can provision a read-only reviewer account for Helium within 1-3 business days. Portal URL: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/heliumhealth
- Interim documentation: We can provide a bridge letter (temporary attestation) within 24 hours while we confirm access levels.
- SOC 2 Type II report: We typically share the full report via the portal. If you require a one-off PDF sent to a distribution list, we can accommodate after verifying your NDA/role-based access.

Requested items from Helium to speed this up:
1) Confirm reviewer emails to provision (we'll create accounts with least privilege).
2) Confirm whether you need a PDF copy immediately or portal-only.
3) If you need a BAA or DPA draft, we can share our standard template; I'll include a link below.

Timeline:
- Portal invite: 1-3 business days after we receive reviewer emails and your preferred access scope.
- Bridge letter: within 24 hours of confirmation.
- Full report: portal delivery once reviewer accounts are provisioned and access terms agreed.

Links and resources:
- Trust Portal: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/heliumhealth
- Standard DPA/BAA template: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-example-dpa

I've also answered several fields in the attached VSQ where we can respond without an architecture deep-dive. If you want, Ben or Marissa can schedule a short technical review with our infra team.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

[Inline: Selected VSQ answers added to Helium_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx]
